basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old tech enthusiast based in Manchester, UK. Recently graduated with a degree in Media Studies, I'm currently working part-time at a local electronics store. I'm passionate about gaming and audio technology, spending most evenings exploring the latest gear or gaming with friends online. I usually browse Reddit in the late evenings and weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time at local gigs or trying out new cafes around town.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise primarily stems from my academic background in media studies and my current job at an electronics store, where I get hands-on experience with various audio and gaming products. I've developed a keen interest in audio tech through self-learning and community engagement.
